verses.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
verses.modern: Many people have undertaken to write an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us.

verses.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
verses.modern: They wrote what was passed on to us by those who were eyewitnesses from the beginning and who became servants of the word.

verses.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
verses.modern: It seemed good to me as well, having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, to write an orderly account for You, most excellent Theophilus.

verses.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
verses.modern: I write so that You may know the certainty of the things You have been taught.

verses.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
verses.modern: In the days of Herod, king of Judaea, there was a priest named Zacharias, of the division of Abijah. his wife was a descendant of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

verses.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
verses.modern: Both of them were righteous before God. They walked in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord without fault.

verses.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
verses.modern: They had no child, because Elisabeth was barren, and they were both very old.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
verses.modern: One day while Zacharias was serving as priest before God in the order of His division,

verses.kjv: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
verses.modern: it was his lot, according to the priestly custom, to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

verses.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
verses.modern: The whole crowd of people was praying outside at the hour of incense.

verses.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.modern: An angel of the Lord appeared to Him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

verses.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
verses.modern: When Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear came over him.

verses.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
verses.modern: But the angel said to him, "Do not be afraid, Zacharias, for your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elisabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
verses.modern: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

verses.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
verses.modern: He will be great in the sight of the Lord. He will drink no wine or strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from His mother's womb.

verses.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
verses.modern: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

verses.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
verses.modern: He will go before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous — to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."

verses.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
verses.modern: Zacharias said to the angel, "How will I know this? For I am an old man, and my wife is very old."

verses.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
verses.modern: The angel answered him, "I am Gabriel. I stand in the presence of God, and I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

verses.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
verses.modern: Because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their time, you will be silent and unable to speak until the day these things happen."

verses.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
verses.modern: The people were waiting for Zacharias and wondered why he was taking so long in the temple.

verses.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
verses.modern: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them and remained unable to speak.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
verses.modern: When the days of his service were completed, he went home.

verses.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
verses.modern: After those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and she kept herself in seclusion for five months. She said,

verses.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
verses.modern: "This is what the Lord has done for me in the days when He looked on me, to take away my disgrace among people."

verses.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.modern: In the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee called Nazareth,

verses.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
verses.modern: to a virgin engaged to a man named Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

verses.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
verses.modern: The angel came to her and said, "Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with You. You are blessed among women."

verses.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
verses.modern: She was troubled at His words and wondered what kind of greeting this could be.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
verses.modern: The angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

verses.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
verses.modern: You will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and you shall call His name JESUS.

verses.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
verses.modern: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Highest. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David.

verses.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
verses.modern: He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and his kingdom will have no end."

verses.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
verses.modern: Mary said to the angel, "How will this be, since I have not known a man?"

verses.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
verses.modern: The angel answered her, "The Holy Ghost will come upon You, and the power of the Highest will overshadow You. Therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of You will be called the Son of God.

verses.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
verses.modern: Your cousin Elisabeth has also conceived a son in her old age. This is the sixth month for her who was called barren.

verses.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
verses.modern: For nothing is impossible with God."

verses.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
verses.modern: Mary said, "I am the servant of the Lord. Let it be to me according to your word." And the angel departed from her.

verses.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
verses.modern: In those days Mary arose and went quickly into the hill country, to a city of Judah.

verses.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
verses.modern: She entered the house of Zacharias and greeted Elisabeth.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
verses.modern: When Elisabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb. Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
verses.modern: She cried out with a loud voice and said, "Blessed are You among women, and blessed is the fruit of Your womb!

verses.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.modern: Why is this granted to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

verses.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.modern: The moment Your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

verses.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
verses.modern: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her from the Lord."

verses.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
verses.modern: Mary said, "My soul magnifies the Lord,

verses.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
verses.modern: and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.

verses.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
verses.modern: For He has looked on the humble condition of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.

verses.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
verses.modern: He who is mighty has done great things for me, and holy is His name.

verses.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
verses.modern: His mercy is on those who fear Him from generation to generation.

verses.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.modern: He has shown strength with His arm. He has scattered the proud in the thoughts of their hearts.

verses.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
verses.modern: He has brought down the mighty from their thrones and lifted up the lowly.

verses.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
verses.modern: He has filled the hungry with good things, and the rich He has sent away empty.

verses.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
verses.modern: He has helped His servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy,

verses.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
verses.modern: as He spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his descendants forever."

verses.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
verses.modern: Mary stayed with her about three months and then returned to her own home.

verses.kjv: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
verses.modern: When the time came for Elisabeth to give birth, she had a son.

verses.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
verses.modern: Her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had shown great mercy to her, and they rejoiced with her.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
verses.modern: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him Zacharias after his father.

verses.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
verses.modern: His mother said, "No — he shall be called John."

verses.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
verses.modern: They said to her, "None of your family is called by that name."

verses.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
verses.modern: They made signs to his father, asking what he wanted the child to be called.

verses.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
verses.modern: He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, "His name is John." They were all amazed.

verses.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
verses.modern: Immediately his mouth was opened and his tongue was freed, and he spoke and praised God.

verses.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
verses.modern: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these things were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

verses.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.modern: All who heard these things kept them in their hearts and said, "What then will this child be?" For the hand of the Lord was with Him.

verses.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
verses.modern: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost and prophesied, saying,

verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
verses.modern: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, for He has visited and redeemed His people.

verses.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
verses.modern: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,

verses.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
verses.modern: as He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from long ago:

verses.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
verses.modern: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

verses.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
verses.modern: to show the mercy promised to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,

verses.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
verses.modern: the oath He swore to our father Abraham:

verses.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
verses.modern: to grant us that we, being rescued from the hand of our enemies, might serve Him without fear,

verses.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
verses.modern: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.

verses.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
verses.modern: And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Highest, for you will go before the Lord to prepare His ways,

verses.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
verses.modern: to give His people knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

verses.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
verses.modern: through the tender mercy of our God, by which the dayspring from on high has visited us,

verses.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
verses.modern: to give light to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace."

verses.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
verses.modern: The child grew and grew strong in spirit, and he was in the wilderness until the day he was presented to Israel.

chapters.summary: The angel Gabriel appears to Zacharias in the temple, announcing that his wife Elisabeth will bear a son named John. Gabriel then visits the virgin Mary in Nazareth and tells her she will conceive the Son of the Highest by the Holy Ghost. Mary visits Elisabeth, sings the Magnificat, and John the Baptist is born.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
verses.modern: In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be registered.

verses.kjv: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
verses.modern: This was the first registration, made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.

verses.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
verses.modern: Everyone went to be registered, each to His own city.

verses.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
verses.modern: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David.

verses.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
verses.modern: He went to be registered with Mary, his promised wife, who was expecting a child.

verses.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
verses.modern: While they were there, the time came for her to give birth.

verses.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.modern: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped Him in cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them at the inn.

verses.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
verses.modern: In that region there were shepherds staying in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

verses.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
verses.modern: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were greatly afraid.

verses.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
verses.modern: The angel said to them, "Do not be afraid, for I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all people.

verses.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
verses.modern: For to You is born this day in the city of David a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
verses.modern: This will be a sign to You: You will find the baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger."

verses.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
verses.modern: Suddenly there was with the angel a great crowd of the heavenly host praising God and saying,

verses.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
verses.modern: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
verses.modern: When the angels had gone away into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, "Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us."

verses.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verses.modern: They went quickly and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in a manger.

verses.kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
verses.modern: When they had seen Him, they spread the word about what they had been told concerning this child.

verses.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
verses.modern: All who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds told them.

verses.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
verses.modern: But Mary kept all these things and pondered them in her heart.

verses.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
verses.modern: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, just as it had been told to them.

verses.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.modern: When eight days had passed for the circumcision of the child, he was named JESUS, the name given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

verses.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
verses.modern: When the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were completed, they brought him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord,

verses.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
verses.modern: as it is written in the law of the Lord: "Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord."

verses.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
verses.modern: They also came to offer a sacrifice as stated in the law of the Lord: a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
verses.modern: There was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. He was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Ghost was upon Him.

verses.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
verses.modern: It had been revealed to Him by the Holy Ghost that He would not see death before He had seen the Lord's Christ.

verses.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
verses.modern: He came by the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what the law required,

verses.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.modern: Simeon took Him up in His arms and blessed God and said,

verses.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verses.modern: "Lord, now You are letting Your servant depart in peace, according to Your word;

verses.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
verses.modern: for my eyes have seen Your salvation,

verses.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
verses.modern: which You have prepared before all people —

verses.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
verses.modern: a light for revelation to the Gentiles and the glory of Your people Israel."

verses.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
verses.modern: Joseph and his mother marveled at what was said about Him.

verses.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
verses.modern: Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, "This child is appointed for the fall and rising of many in Israel, and for a sign that will be spoken against —

verses.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
verses.modern: and a sword will pierce through your own soul too — so that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed."

verses.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
verses.modern: There was also a prophetess, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was very old. She had lived with her husband seven years from her marriage,

verses.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
verses.modern: and she was a widow of about eighty-four years. She never left the temple but served God with fasting and prayer night and day.

verses.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Coming up at that very moment, she gave thanks to the Lord and spoke about Him to all who were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
verses.modern: When they had done everything required by the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city of Nazareth.

verses.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.modern: The child grew and grew strong, filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.

verses.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
verses.modern: His parents went to Jerusalem every year for the feast of the Passover.

verses.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
verses.modern: When He was twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the feast.

verses.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
verses.modern: When the days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. His parents did not know it.

verses.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
verses.modern: Thinking He was in the traveling group, they went a day's journey. Then they began looking for Him among their relatives and friends.

verses.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
verses.modern: When they did not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem, searching for Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verses.modern: After three days they found Him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

verses.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
verses.modern: All who heard Him were astonished at His understanding and His answers.

verses.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
verses.modern: When they saw Him, they were amazed. His mother said to Him, "Son, why have You treated us like this? Your father and I have been searching for You with great anxiety."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
verses.modern: He said to them, "Why were You searching for Me? Did You not know that I must be about My Father's business?"

verses.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
verses.modern: But they did not understand what He said to them.

verses.modern: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judaea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

verses.modern: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low. The crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.

verses.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
verses.modern: All flesh shall see the salvation of God."

verses.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.modern: He said to the crowds that came out to be baptized by him, "You generation of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.modern: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance, and do not start saying to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you, God is able to raise up children for Abraham from these stones.

verses.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.modern: Even now the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Every tree that does not produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire."

verses.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
verses.modern: The people asked him, "What shall we do then?"

verses.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
verses.modern: He answered them, "Whoever has two coats, let him share with the one who has none. Whoever has food, let him do likewise."

verses.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
verses.modern: Tax collectors also came to be baptized and said to him, "Master, what shall we do?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Collect no more than you are authorized to collect."

verses.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
verses.modern: Soldiers also asked him, "And what about us — what shall we do?" He said to them, "Do not extort money from anyone by force, and do not make false accusations. Be content with your wages."

verses.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
verses.modern: The people were in a state of expectation, and everyone was wondering in their hearts whether John might be the Christ.

verses.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
verses.modern: John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But One mightier than I is coming, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize You with the Holy Ghost and with fire.

verses.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
verses.modern: His winnowing fork is in His hand, and He will thoroughly clear His threshing floor. He will gather the wheat into His barn, but the chaff He will burn with unquenchable fire."

verses.modern: With many other exhortations He preached the good news to the people.

verses.modern: But Herod the tetrarch, being rebuked by John for Herodias his brother Philip's wife and for all the evil things Herod had done,

verses.modern: When all the people were baptized, Jesus also was baptized. As He was praying, heaven was opened,

verses.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
verses.modern: and the Holy Ghost descended on Him in bodily form like a dove. A voice came from heaven: "You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased."

verses.modern: the son of Joanna, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, the son of Neri,

verses.modern: the son of Simeon, the son of Juda, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

verses.modern: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

verses.modern: the son of Aminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Esrom, the son of Phares, the son of Juda,

verses.modern: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Thara, the son of Nachor,

chapters.summary: John the Baptist preaches repentance and baptizes in the Jordan, warning the crowds to bring forth fruits worthy of repentance. Jesus is baptized, the Holy Ghost descends on Him like a dove, and the Father's voice declares Him His beloved Son. Luke traces Jesus's genealogy from Joseph back through David and Abraham to Adam.

verses.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
verses.modern: Jesus, full of the Holy Ghost, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

verses.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
verses.modern: where He was tempted by the devil for forty days. He ate nothing during those days, and when they were over He was hungry.

verses.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
verses.modern: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "It is written: 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.'"

verses.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.modern: The devil took him up to a high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

verses.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
verses.modern: The devil said to him, "I will give you all this power and their glory, for it has been handed over to me, and I give it to whoever I wish.

verses.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
verses.modern: If You therefore worship me, all of it will be Yours."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "Get behind Me, Satan! For it is written: 'You shall worship the Lord Your God, and Him only shall You serve.'"

verses.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
verses.modern: He brought Him to Jerusalem, set Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to Him, "If You are the Son of God, throw Yourself down from here.

verses.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
verses.modern: For it is written: 'He will give His angels charge over You, to guard You,'

verses.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.modern: and 'in their hands they will lift You up, lest You strike Your foot against a stone.'"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "It is said: 'You shall not tempt the Lord Your God.'"

verses.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
verses.modern: When the devil had finished every temptation, he departed from Him until an opportune time.

verses.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
verses.modern: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit to Galilee, and news about Him spread through all the surrounding region.

verses.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
verses.modern: He taught in their synagogues, and everyone praised Him.

verses.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
verses.modern: He came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. On the Sabbath day He went into the synagogue, as was His custom, and stood up to read.

verses.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
verses.modern: The scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the scroll and found the place where it was written:

verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
verses.modern: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He has anointed Me to preach the gospel to the poor. He has sent Me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to set at liberty those who are oppressed,

verses.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
verses.modern: to preach the acceptable year of the Lord."

verses.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.modern: He closed the scroll, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him.

verses.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
verses.modern: He began to say to them, "Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing."

verses.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
verses.modern: All spoke well of Him and were amazed at the gracious words coming from His mouth. They said, "Is this not Joseph's son?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
verses.modern: He said to them, "You will certainly quote this proverb to Me: 'Physician, heal yourself.' Do here in your hometown what we have heard You did in Capernaum."

verses.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
verses.modern: He said, "Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

verses.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
verses.modern: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up for three years and six months, and great famine came over all the land.

verses.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
verses.modern: Yet Elijah was sent to none of them — only to Zarephath, a city of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

verses.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
verses.modern: There were also many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, and none of them was cleansed — only Naaman the Syrian."

verses.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
verses.modern: All in the synagogue were filled with fury when they heard these things.

verses.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
verses.modern: They rose up, drove Him out of the city, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which their city was built, intending to throw Him off the cliff.

verses.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way.
verses.modern: But He passed through the midst of them and went on His way.

verses.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
verses.modern: He went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and was teaching them on the Sabbath days.

verses.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
verses.modern: They were astonished at His teaching, for His word was with authority.

verses.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
verses.modern: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean devil, and he cried out with a loud voice,

verses.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
verses.modern: "Leave us alone! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are — the Holy One of God."

verses.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
verses.modern: Jesus rebuked Him and said, "Be silent, and come out of Him!" The devil threw the man down in the middle of the crowd and came out of Him without hurting Him.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
verses.modern: They were all amazed and said to one another, "What kind of word is this? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!"

verses.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
verses.modern: News about Him spread to every place in the surrounding region.

verses.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
verses.modern: He left the synagogue and entered Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was suffering from a severe fever, and they asked Him to help her.

verses.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
verses.modern: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She immediately rose and began serving them.

verses.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.modern: When the sun was setting, all who had sick people with various diseases brought them to Him. He laid His hands on every one of them and healed them.

verses.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
verses.modern: Devils also came out of many, crying out and saying, "You are Christ the Son of God!" He rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ.

verses.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
verses.modern: When day came, He left and went to a deserted place. The people looked for him, came to him, and tried to keep Him from leaving them.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
verses.modern: But He said to them, "I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also, for that is why I was sent."

verses.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.modern: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

chapters.summary: Jesus, full of the Holy Ghost, is tempted by the devil in the wilderness for forty days and overcomes every temptation with Scripture. He reads from Isaiah in the synagogue at Nazareth and declares the prophecy fulfilled, but the people of His hometown reject Him and try to throw Him off a cliff. He casts out demons and heals the sick in Capernaum.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
verses.modern: One day, as the crowd pressed around Him to hear the word of God, He was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

verses.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.modern: He saw two boats at the shore of the lake. The fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.

verses.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
verses.modern: He got into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the shore. Then He sat down and taught the people from the boat.

verses.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
verses.modern: When He had finished speaking, He said to Simon, "Put out into the deep water and let down your nets for a catch."

verses.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
verses.modern: Simon answered, "Master, we have worked hard all night and caught nothing. But at Your word I will let down the net."

verses.kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
verses.modern: When they had done this, they caught a great number of fish, and their net began to break.

verses.kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
verses.modern: They signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. They came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

verses.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
verses.modern: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell down at Jesus' knees and said, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, O Lord."

verses.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
verses.modern: He was astonished — and so were all who were with Him — at the catch of fish they had taken.

verses.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
verses.modern: So also were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, "Do not be afraid. From now on you will be catching men."

verses.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
verses.modern: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything and followed Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.modern: While He was in one of the cities, a man full of leprosy saw Jesus. He fell on His face and begged Him, "Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean."

verses.kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
verses.modern: Jesus stretched out His hand and touched Him, saying, "I am willing — be clean." Immediately the leprosy left Him.

verses.kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.modern: He told him to tell no one, but said, "Go and show yourself to the priest, and offer what Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a witness to them."

verses.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.modern: But the news about Him spread even more. Large crowds came together to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

verses.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
verses.modern: But He would withdraw to deserted places and pray.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
verses.modern: One day as He was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. They had come from every village of Galilee and Judaea and from Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was present to heal.

verses.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
verses.modern: Some men brought on a bed a man who was paralyzed, and they tried to bring him in and lay Him before Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verses.modern: Finding no way to bring Him in because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered Him on His mat through the tiles into the middle of the room, right before Jesus.

verses.kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
verses.modern: When He saw their faith, He said, "Man, Your sins are forgiven You."

verses.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
verses.modern: The scribes and Pharisees began to question this, saying, "Who is this who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

verses.kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
verses.modern: Jesus knew their thoughts and answered them, "Why are You reasoning in Your hearts?

verses.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
verses.modern: Which is easier — to say, 'Your sins are forgiven You,' or to say, 'Rise and walk'?

verses.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
verses.modern: But so that You may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins" — He said to the paralyzed man — "I say to You, rise, take up Your mat, and go home."

verses.kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
verses.modern: Immediately He rose before them all, took up what He had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
verses.modern: They were all amazed and glorified God. They were filled with awe and said, "We have seen remarkable things today."

verses.kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
verses.modern: After this He went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax booth. He said to Him, "Follow Me."

verses.kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
verses.modern: Levi left everything, rose up, and followed Him.

verses.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
verses.modern: Levi made a great banquet for Him at His house. A large crowd of tax collectors and others were reclining at the table with them.

verses.kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
verses.modern: The scribes and Pharisees complained to His disciples, saying, "Why do You eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Those who are well have no need of a doctor, but those who are sick do.

verses.kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.modern: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
verses.modern: They said to Him, "John's disciples fast often and pray, and the disciples of the Pharisees do likewise. But Your disciples eat and drink."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.modern: He said to them, "Can You make the wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them?

verses.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
verses.modern: The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them — then they will fast in those days."

verses.kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
verses.modern: He also told them a parable: "No one tears a piece from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If He does, the new piece will not match the old.

verses.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
verses.modern: No one puts new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will be spilled, and the skins will be ruined.

verses.kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
verses.modern: New wine must be put into new wineskins, and both are preserved.

verses.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
verses.modern: No one who has drunk old wine wants the new right away, for He says, 'The old is better.'"

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches from Simon's boat, then commands a miraculous catch of fish so great the nets begin to break. He cleanses a leper, heals a paralytic lowered through the roof, and calls Levi the tax collector to follow Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.modern: On a Sabbath, as He was passing through the grain fields, His disciples plucked heads of grain, rubbed them in their hands, and ate them.

verses.kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.modern: Some of the Pharisees said, "Why are You doing what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.modern: Jesus answered them, "Have You not read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with Him —

verses.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.modern: how He entered the house of God and took and ate the showbread, and gave some to those with Him? This bread is not lawful for anyone to eat except the priests alone."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.modern: He said to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.modern: On another Sabbath He entered the synagogue and taught. A man was there whose right hand was withered.

verses.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.modern: The scribes and Pharisees were watching Him closely to see whether He would heal on the Sabbath, so they could find a reason to accuse Him.

verses.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.modern: But He knew their thoughts and said to the man with the withered hand, "Rise and stand in the middle." He rose and stood there.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.modern: Jesus said to them, "I ask You one thing: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil? To save life or to destroy it?"

verses.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.modern: He looked around at all of them and said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did so, and his hand was restored.

verses.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.modern: They were filled with fury and discussed with one another what they might do to Jesus.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.modern: In those days He went out to the mountain to pray and spent the whole night in prayer to God.

verses.kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.modern: When day came, He called His disciples and chose twelve of them, whom He named apostles:

verses.kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.modern: Simon (whom he named Peter), Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

verses.kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.modern: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

verses.kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.modern: Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

verses.kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.modern: He came down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of His disciples was there, along with a great number of people from all Judaea and Jerusalem and from the coastal region of Tyre and Sidon. They came to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases.

verses.kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.modern: Those troubled by unclean spirits were also healed.

verses.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.modern: The whole crowd was trying to touch Him, because power was going out from Him and healing everyone.

verses.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: He lifted up His eyes on His disciples and said: "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.modern: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.modern: Blessed are You when people hate You, exclude You, insult You, and reject Your name as evil because of the Son of Man.

verses.kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.modern: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for Your reward is great in heaven. Their fathers treated the prophets the same way.

verses.kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.modern: But woe to You who are rich, for You have already received Your comfort.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.modern: Woe to You who are full now, for You will hunger. Woe to You who laugh now, for You will mourn and weep.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.modern: Woe to You when everyone speaks well of You, for that is what their fathers did to the false prophets.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.modern: But I say to You who hear: Love Your enemies. Do good to those who hate You.

verses.kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.modern: Bless those who curse You. Pray for those who mistreat You.

verses.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
verses.modern: To the one who strikes you on the cheek, offer the other also. To the one who takes your coat, do not withhold your shirt either.

verses.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.modern: Give to everyone who asks of You. From the one who takes your things, do not demand them back.

verses.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.modern: Do to others as You would have them do to You.

verses.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.modern: If You love those who love You, what credit is that to You? Even sinners love those who love them.

verses.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.modern: If You do good to those who do good to You, what credit is that to You? Even sinners do the same.

verses.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.modern: If You lend to those from whom You expect repayment, what credit is that to You? Even sinners lend to sinners to get back the same amount.

verses.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.modern: But love Your enemies, do good, and lend without expecting anything back. Your reward will be great, and You will be children of the Highest, for He is kind to the ungrateful and the evil.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.modern: Be merciful, just as Your Father is merciful.

verses.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.modern: Do not judge, and You will not be judged. Do not condemn, and You will not be condemned. Forgive, and You will be forgiven.

verses.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.modern: Give, and it will be given to You — good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be poured into Your lap. For with the measure You use, it will be measured back to You."

verses.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.modern: He also told them a parable: "Can the blind lead the blind? Will they not both fall into a ditch?

verses.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.modern: A disciple is not above His teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like His teacher.

verses.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.modern: Why do You see the speck in Your brother's eye but fail to notice the beam in Your own eye?

verses.kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.modern: How can You say to Your brother, 'Brother, let me remove the speck from Your eye,' when You don't see the beam in Your own eye? You hypocrite — first take the beam out of Your own eye, and then You will see clearly to remove the speck from Your brother's eye.

verses.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.modern: A good tree does not produce corrupt fruit, and a corrupt tree does not produce good fruit.

verses.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.modern: Every tree is known by its own fruit. People do not gather figs from thorns, or grapes from a bramble bush.

verses.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.modern: A good man brings forth good from the good stored in His heart. An evil man brings forth evil from the evil stored in His heart. For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

verses.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.modern: Why do You call Me 'Lord, Lord,' and not do what I say?

verses.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.modern: Everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and does them — I will show You what He is like.

verses.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.modern: He is like a man who built a house and dug deep, laying the foundation on rock. When the flood rose, the stream beat against that house but could not shake it, because it was built on rock.

verses.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.modern: But the one who hears and does not act is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. When the stream beat against it, it immediately collapsed, and the ruin was great."

chapters.summary: Jesus defends His disciples for plucking grain on the Sabbath and heals a man with a withered hand, provoking the scribes and Pharisees. He chooses the twelve apostles and delivers the Sermon on the Plain, teaching about blessings and woes, loving one's enemies, judging others, and building on a sure foundation.

verses.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.modern: When He had finished all His sayings in the hearing of the people, he entered Capernaum.

verses.kjv: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.modern: A certain centurion had a servant who was dear to Him, and the servant was sick and near death.

verses.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.modern: When the centurion heard about Jesus, He sent some elders of the Jews to Him, asking Him to come and heal His servant.

verses.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.modern: When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with Him, saying, "He is worthy for You to do this,

verses.kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.modern: for He loves our nation and built us a synagogue."

verses.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.modern: Jesus went with them. When He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to say, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy that You should come under my roof.

verses.kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.modern: Therefore I did not think myself worthy to come to You. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

verses.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.modern: For I myself am a man placed under authority, with soldiers under me. I say to one, 'Go,' and He goes; to another, 'Come,' and He comes; to my servant, 'Do this,' and He does it."

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.modern: When Jesus heard this, He marveled at the centurion and turned to the crowd following him. He said, "I tell You, not even in Israel have I found such great faith."

verses.kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.modern: When those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the servant well.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.modern: Soon afterward He went to a city called Nain. His disciples and a large crowd went with Him.

verses.kjv: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.modern: As He drew near to the gate of the city, a man who had died was being carried out — the only son of His mother, and she was a widow. A large crowd from the city was with her.

verses.kjv: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.modern: When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said, "Do not weep."

verses.kjv: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.modern: He came and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stopped. He said, "Young man, I say to You, arise."

verses.kjv: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.modern: The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave Him back to His mother.

verses.kjv: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.modern: Fear came on everyone, and they glorified God, saying, "A great prophet has risen among us!" and "God has visited His people!"

verses.kjv: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.modern: This report about Him spread through all Judaea and the surrounding region.

verses.kjv: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.modern: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

verses.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.modern: John called two of his disciples and sent them to the Lord, saying, "Are You the One who is to come, or should we look for another?"

verses.kjv: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.modern: When the men came to Him, they said, "John the Baptist has sent us to you, saying, 'Are you the One who is to come, or should we look for another?'"

verses.kjv: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.modern: In that same hour He healed many people of sicknesses and afflictions and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.modern: He answered them, "Go and tell John what you have seen and heard: the blind receive sight, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, the poor have the gospel preached to them.

verses.kjv: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.modern: Blessed is the one who is not offended by Me."

verses.kjv: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.modern: When John's messengers had gone, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

verses.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
verses.modern: What did You go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Those who wear fine clothes and live in luxury are in royal palaces.

verses.kjv: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.modern: What did You go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell You, and much more than a prophet.

verses.kjv: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.modern: This is the one about whom it is written: 'I send My messenger before Your face, who will prepare Your way before You.'

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.modern: I tell You, among those born of women there is no greater prophet than John the Baptist. Yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than He."

verses.kjv: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.modern: All the people who heard him, even the tax collectors, acknowledged God's justice, having been baptized with John's baptism.

verses.kjv: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
