verses.modern: But the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God's purpose for themselves, not having been baptized by John.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.modern: The Lord said, "To what then shall I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

verses.kjv: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.modern: They are like children sitting in the marketplace, calling to one another: 'We played the flute for You, and You did not dance; we sang a lament, and You did not weep.'

verses.kjv: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.modern: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and You say, 'He has a devil.'

verses.kjv: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.modern: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and You say, 'Look, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!'

verses.kjv: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.modern: Yet wisdom is vindicated by all her children."

verses.kjv: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
verses.modern: One of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with Him. He entered the Pharisee's house and reclined at the table.

verses.kjv: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.modern: A woman of the city who was a sinner learned that he was reclining at the Pharisee's house. She brought an alabaster flask of ointment,

verses.kjv: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.modern: and standing behind Him at His feet, weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears. She wiped them with her hair, kissed His feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

verses.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.modern: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who and what kind of woman is touching Him — she is a sinner."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.modern: Jesus answered Him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." He said, "Master, say it."

verses.kjv: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.modern: "A certain creditor had two debtors. One owed five hundred denarii and the other fifty.

verses.kjv: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.modern: When neither of them could pay, He cancelled both debts. Which of them will love Him more?"

verses.kjv: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.modern: Simon answered, "The one who had the larger debt cancelled, I suppose." He said to Him, "You have judged correctly."

verses.kjv: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.modern: Turning to the woman he said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house. You gave Me no water for My feet, but she washed My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

verses.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.modern: You gave Me no kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I came in.

verses.kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.modern: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with ointment.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
verses.modern: Therefore I tell you, her many sins are forgiven — she loved much. But the one who is forgiven little loves little."

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.modern: He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."

verses.kjv: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.modern: Those reclining at the table began to say among themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"

verses.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.modern: He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."

chapters.summary: Jesus heals the centurion's servant from a distance, marveling at the centurion's faith, and raises a widow's dead son at Nain. John the Baptist sends messengers asking if Jesus is the one who was to come, and Jesus answers by pointing to His miracles. A sinful woman washes Jesus's feet with her tears and anoints them with ointment, and Jesus forgives her sins.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
verses.modern: After this He traveled through every city and village, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The twelve were with Him,

verses.kjv: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.modern: and also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and sicknesses: Mary called Magdalene, out of whom seven devils had gone,

verses.kjv: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.modern: Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others. These women served Him out of their own means.

verses.kjv: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.modern: When a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Him from every city, He spoke by a parable:

verses.kjv: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.modern: "A sower went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the path, was trampled, and the birds of the air devoured it.

verses.kjv: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.modern: Some fell on the rock, and as it grew up it withered away because it had no moisture.

verses.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.modern: Some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up with it and choked it.

verses.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.modern: Other seed fell on good ground and grew up and produced a hundredfold." As He said this, He called out, "Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear."

verses.kjv: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.modern: His disciples asked Him what this parable meant.

verses.kjv: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.modern: He said, "To you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God, but to others I speak in parables, so that seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.

verses.kjv: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.modern: Now this is what the parable means: The seed is the word of God.

verses.kjv: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.modern: Those along the path are those who hear, but then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.

verses.kjv: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.modern: Those on the rock are those who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, and in a time of testing they fall away.

verses.kjv: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.modern: The seed that fell among thorns — these are those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life's worries, riches, and pleasures, and they never mature.

verses.kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.modern: The seed on the good ground — these are those who hear the word with an honest and good heart, hold it fast, and produce fruit with patience.

verses.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.modern: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed. He puts it on a stand so that those who enter may see the light.

verses.kjv: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.modern: For nothing is secret that will not be revealed, and nothing is hidden that will not be known and come to light.

verses.kjv: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
verses.modern: Therefore take care how you hear. Whoever has, more will be given to him. Whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken from him."

verses.kjv: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.modern: His mother and brothers came to Him, but they could not reach Him because of the crowd.

verses.kjv: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.modern: Someone told him, "Your mother and your brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You."

verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.modern: He answered them, "My mother and My brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it."

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.modern: One day He got into a boat with His disciples and said, "Let us go over to the other side of the lake." They set out.

verses.kjv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
verses.modern: As they were sailing He fell asleep. A windstorm came down on the lake, the boat was filling with water, and they were in danger.

verses.kjv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.modern: They came to Him and woke Him, saying, "Master, Master, we are perishing!" He rose and rebuked the wind and the raging waves. They stopped, and there was calm.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Where is your faith?" Afraid and amazed, they said to one another, "Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him!"

verses.kjv: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.modern: They sailed to the region of the Gadarenes, which is across from Galilee.

verses.kjv: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
verses.modern: When He stepped ashore, a man from the city met him who had had devils for a long time. He wore no clothes and did not live in a house but among the tombs.

verses.kjv: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.modern: When He saw Jesus, He cried out, fell down before Him, and said with a loud voice, "What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You, do not torment me!"

verses.kjv: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.modern: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was bound with chains and shackles, He would break them and be driven by the devil into the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.modern: Jesus asked Him, "What is Your name?" He said, "Legion," because many devils had entered Him.

verses.kjv: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.modern: They begged Him not to command them to go into the abyss.

verses.kjv: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.modern: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the hillside. The devils begged Him to let them enter the pigs, and He allowed it.

verses.kjv: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.modern: The devils came out of the man and entered the pigs. The herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

verses.kjv: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.modern: When the herdsmen saw what had happened, they fled and reported it in the city and in the countryside.

verses.kjv: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.modern: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the devils had gone, sitting at Jesus' feet, clothed and in His right mind. They were afraid.

verses.kjv: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.modern: Those who had seen it told them how the demon-possessed man had been healed.

verses.kjv: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
verses.modern: The whole crowd from the region of the Gadarenes asked Him to leave them, for they were seized with great fear. So He got into the boat and returned.

verses.kjv: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.modern: The man from whom the devils had gone begged to be with Him. But Jesus sent Him away, saying,

verses.kjv: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
verses.modern: "Return to Your home and tell how much God has done for You." He went away and proclaimed throughout the whole city how much Jesus had done for Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.modern: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they were all waiting for Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
verses.modern: A man named Jairus, who was a ruler of the synagogue, came and fell at Jesus' feet. He begged Him to come to His house,

verses.kjv: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.modern: for He had an only daughter about twelve years old, and she was dying. As Jesus went, the crowd pressed around Him.

verses.kjv: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.modern: A woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years — who had spent all she had on doctors and could not be healed by any of them —

verses.kjv: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verses.modern: came up behind Him and touched the edge of His garment. Immediately her discharge of blood stopped.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Who touched Me?" When all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the crowd surrounds you and presses in on You — how can You ask, 'Who touched Me?'"

verses.kjv: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Someone has touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me."

verses.kjv: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.modern: When the woman saw that she was discovered, she came trembling. Falling down before Him, she declared in front of all the people why she had touched him and how she had been healed immediately.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.modern: He said to her, "Daughter, be of good comfort — your faith has made you whole. Go in peace."

verses.kjv: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.modern: While He was still speaking, someone came from the ruler of the synagogue's house and said, "Your daughter is dead. Trouble not the Master."

verses.kjv: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.modern: Hearing this, Jesus answered Him, "Do not be afraid — only believe, and she will be made well."

verses.kjv: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.modern: When He came to the house, He allowed no one to enter with him except Peter, James, John, and the child's father and mother.

verses.kjv: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.modern: All were weeping and mourning for her. He said, "Do not weep. She is not dead, but sleeping."

verses.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.modern: They laughed at Him, knowing she was dead.

verses.kjv: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.modern: He took her by the hand and called out, "Child, arise!"

verses.kjv: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.modern: Her spirit returned, and she got up immediately. He directed that something be given to her to eat.

verses.kjv: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.modern: Her parents were astonished, but He directed them to tell no one what had happened.

chapters.summary: Jesus travels through cities and villages preaching, accompanied by the twelve and several women who provide for Him. He tells the parable of the sower, calms a storm on the sea, casts a legion of demons out of a man among the tombs, heals a woman with a twelve-year flow of blood, and raises Jairus's daughter from the dead.

verses.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
verses.modern: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all devils, and the ability to cure diseases.

verses.kjv: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
verses.modern: He sent them out to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Take nothing for the journey — no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, and no extra coat.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
verses.modern: Whatever house You enter, stay there until You leave that place.

verses.kjv: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
verses.modern: Wherever they do not receive You, shake off the dust from Your feet as a testimony against them when You leave that city."

verses.kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
verses.modern: They left and went through the villages, preaching the gospel and healing everywhere.

verses.kjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
verses.modern: Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was happening, and he was perplexed. Some were saying that John had risen from the dead,

verses.kjv: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
verses.modern: others that Elijah had appeared, and others that one of the ancient prophets had risen.

verses.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
verses.modern: Herod said, "John I had beheaded — but who is this about whom I hear such things?" He wanted to see Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
verses.modern: When the apostles returned, they told Him all they had done. He took them and withdrew privately to a place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

verses.kjv: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
verses.modern: When the crowds learned of it, they followed Him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who had need of healing.

verses.kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
verses.modern: As the day began to draw to a close, the twelve came to Him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go into the surrounding villages and countryside to find food and lodging, because we are here in a deserted place."

verses.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
verses.modern: But He said to them, "You give them something to eat." They said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish — unless we go and buy food for all this people."

verses.kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
verses.modern: There were about five thousand men. He said to His disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about fifty."

verses.kjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
verses.modern: They did so, and had everyone sit down.

verses.kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
verses.modern: He took the five loaves and two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave thanks. He broke them and gave them to the disciples to set before the crowd.

verses.kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
verses.modern: They all ate and were filled, and twelve baskets of broken pieces were taken up as leftovers.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
verses.modern: One day as He was praying alone with His disciples nearby, He asked them, "Who do the people say that I am?"

verses.kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
verses.modern: They answered, "John the Baptist. Others say Elijah, and others say that one of the ancient prophets has risen."

verses.kjv: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
verses.modern: He said to them, "But who do You say that I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God."

verses.kjv: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
verses.modern: He strictly charged them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

verses.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
verses.modern: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders and chief priests and scribes. He must be killed, and on the third day be raised."

verses.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
verses.modern: He said to all, "If anyone wants to come after Me, let him deny himself and take up His cross daily and follow Me.

verses.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
verses.modern: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it. But whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.

verses.kjv: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
verses.modern: What does it profit a man if he gains the whole world but loses or forfeits Himself?

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
verses.modern: Whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, of him the Son of Man will be ashamed when He comes in His own glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

verses.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: But truly I tell You, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
verses.modern: About eight days after saying these things, He took Peter, John, and James and went up the mountain to pray.

verses.kjv: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
verses.modern: As He prayed, the fashion of His countenance was altered, and His clothes became white and gleaming.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
verses.modern: Two men were talking with Him — Moses and Elijah —

verses.kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: who appeared in glory and spoke of His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
verses.modern: Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep. When they became fully awake, they saw His glory and the two men standing with Him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
verses.modern: As the men were parting from Him, Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us make three shelters — one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah" — not knowing what he was saying.

verses.kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
verses.modern: While He was saying this, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

verses.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
verses.modern: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is My beloved Son — hear Him!"

verses.kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
verses.modern: When the voice had spoken, Jesus was found alone. They kept silent and told no one in those days anything of what they had seen.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
verses.modern: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a large crowd met Him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
verses.modern: A man in the crowd cried out, "Master, I beg you, look on my son, for He is my only child.

verses.kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
verses.modern: A spirit seizes Him and He suddenly cries out. It throws Him into convulsions and He foams at the mouth. It bruises Him and barely leaves Him.

verses.kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
verses.modern: I begged Your disciples to cast it out, but they could not."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with You and bear with You? Bring Your son here."

verses.kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
verses.modern: As the boy was coming, the devil threw him down and convulsed him. Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

verses.kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
verses.modern: They were all amazed at the majesty of God. While everyone was marveling at all Jesus did, He said to His disciples,

verses.kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
verses.modern: "Let these words sink into Your ears: the Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men."

verses.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
verses.modern: But they did not understand what He said. It was hidden from them so they could not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.

verses.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
verses.modern: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

verses.kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
verses.modern: Jesus, knowing the thought of their hearts, took a child and set Him by His side.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Whoever receives this child in My name receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me. For the one who is least among you all is the one who is great."

verses.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
verses.modern: John answered, "Master, we saw someone casting out devils in your name, and we stopped Him because He does not follow with us."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Do not stop Him, for the one who is not against us is for us."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
verses.modern: When the time drew near for Him to be taken up, He set His face steadfastly to go to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
verses.modern: He sent messengers ahead of Him, and they went into a village of the Samaritans to prepare for Him.

verses.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
verses.modern: But the people did not receive him, because his face was set toward Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
verses.modern: When His disciples James and John saw this, they said, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven and consume them, as Elijah did?"

verses.kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
verses.modern: But He turned and rebuked them and said, "You do not know what spirit you are of.

verses.kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
verses.modern: For the Son of Man has not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them." And they went to another village.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.modern: As they were going along the road, someone said to him, "Lord, I will follow you wherever You go."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head."

verses.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.modern: He said to another, "Follow Me." But He said, "Lord, let me first go and bury my father."

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Let the dead bury their own dead. But You go and proclaim the kingdom of God."

verses.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
verses.modern: Another said, "Lord, I will follow You, but let me first say farewell to those at my home."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."

chapters.summary: Jesus sends the twelve apostles out to preach and heal, then feeds five thousand men with five loaves and two fish. Peter confesses that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus foretells His death and resurrection. Jesus is transfigured on a mountain before Peter, James, and John.

verses.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
verses.modern: After this the Lord appointed seventy others and sent them out two by two ahead of Him into every city and place where He Himself was about to come.

verses.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.modern: He said to them, "The harvest is great, but the workers are few. Pray to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into his harvest.

verses.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
verses.modern: Go — I send You out as lambs among wolves.

verses.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
verses.modern: Carry no purse, no bag, no sandals. Greet no one along the road.

verses.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
verses.modern: Into whatever house You enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house.'

verses.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
verses.modern: If a son of peace is there, Your peace will rest on Him. If not, it will return to You.

verses.kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
verses.modern: Remain in the same house, eating and drinking what they provide, for the worker is worthy of His wages. Do not go from house to house.

verses.kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
verses.modern: Whenever You enter a city and they receive You, eat what is set before You.

verses.kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.modern: Heal the sick there and say to them, 'The kingdom of God has come near to You.'

verses.kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
verses.modern: But when You enter a city and they do not receive You, go into its streets and say,

verses.kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
verses.modern: 'Even the dust of Your city that clings to our feet we wipe off against You. Yet know this: the kingdom of God has come near.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
verses.modern: I tell You, it will be more bearable for Sodom on that day than for that city.

verses.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.modern: Woe to You, Chorazin! Woe to You, Bethsaida! For if the miracles done in You had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
verses.modern: It will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for You.

verses.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
verses.modern: And You, Capernaum — will You be lifted up to heaven? You will be brought down to hell.

verses.kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
verses.modern: Whoever listens to you listens to Me. Whoever rejects you rejects Me. And whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me."

verses.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
verses.modern: The seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the devils are subject to us in Your name!"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
verses.modern: He said to them, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

verses.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
verses.modern: I have given you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will hurt you by any means.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
verses.modern: Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this — that the spirits are subject to you — but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."

verses.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.modern: At that moment Jesus rejoiced in the Spirit and said, "I thank You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that You have hidden these things from the wise and intelligent and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was Your good pleasure.

verses.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
verses.modern: All things have been handed over to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and anyone to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."

verses.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
verses.modern: Turning to His disciples, He said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see what You see.

verses.kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.modern: For I tell You that many prophets and kings wanted to see what You see but did not see it, and to hear what You hear but did not hear it."

verses.kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
verses.modern: A certain lawyer stood up to test Him, saying, "Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

verses.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
verses.modern: He said to Him, "What is written in the law? How do You read it?"

verses.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.modern: He answered, "You shall love the Lord Your God with all Your heart, with all Your soul, with all Your strength, and with all Your mind; and Your neighbor as Yourself."

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
verses.modern: He said to Him, "You have answered correctly. Do this and You will live."

verses.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
verses.modern: But wanting to justify Himself, He said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and He fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped Him of His clothes, beat Him, and left Him half dead.

verses.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
verses.modern: A priest happened to be going down that road. When he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.

verses.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
verses.modern: Likewise a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

verses.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
verses.modern: But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came to where the man was. When he saw him, he had compassion on him.

verses.kjv: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
verses.modern: He went to him, bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

verses.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
verses.modern: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. He said, 'Take care of him, and whatever more you spend I will repay you when I come back.'

verses.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
verses.modern: Which of these three, do you think, proved to be a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of the robbers?"

verses.kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
verses.modern: He said, "The one who showed mercy on him." Jesus said to Him, "Go and do likewise."

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
verses.modern: As they went on their way, He entered a village. A woman named Martha received him into her house.

verses.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
verses.modern: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord's feet and listened to his word.

verses.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
verses.modern: But Martha was distracted with much serving. She came to Him and said, "Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me."

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
verses.modern: The Lord answered her, "Martha, Martha, you are worried and troubled about many things.

verses.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verses.modern: But one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the better part, and it will not be taken away from her."

chapters.summary: Jesus sends out seventy disciples ahead of Him into every city. He pronounces woe on Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum for their unbelief, and tells the parable of the Good Samaritan. He visits the home of Martha and Mary, commending Mary for choosing the better part.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
verses.modern: One day He was praying in a certain place. When He stopped, one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
verses.modern: He said to them, "When You pray, say: Our Father who is in heaven, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

verses.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
verses.modern: Give us day by day our daily bread.

verses.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
verses.modern: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
verses.modern: He said to them, "Which of You will have a friend, and will go to Him at midnight and say, 'Friend, lend me three loaves,

verses.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
verses.modern: for a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before Him'?

verses.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
verses.modern: And He will answer from inside, 'Do not bother me. The door is already shut and my children are with me in bed. I cannot get up and give You anything.'

verses.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
verses.modern: I tell You, though He will not get up and give Him anything because He is His friend, yet because of His persistent asking He will rise and give Him as much as He needs.

verses.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
verses.modern: So I say to You: Ask, and it will be given to You. Seek, and You will find. Knock, and it will be opened to You.

verses.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.modern: For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened.

verses.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
verses.modern: What father among You, if His son asks for bread, will give Him a stone? Or if He asks for a fish, will give Him a snake instead?

verses.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
verses.modern: Or if He asks for an egg, will give Him a scorpion?

verses.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
verses.modern: If You then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to Your children, how much more will Your heavenly Father give the Holy Ghost to those who ask Him!"

verses.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
verses.modern: He was casting out a devil, and it was mute. When the devil had gone out, the mute man spoke, and the people marveled.

verses.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
verses.modern: But some of them said, "He casts out devils by Beelzebub, the ruler of the devils."

verses.kjv: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
verses.modern: Others, to test Him, demanded a sign from heaven.

verses.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
verses.modern: But He knew their thoughts and said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to ruin, and a divided house falls.

verses.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
verses.modern: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? You say I cast out devils by Beelzebub.

verses.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
verses.modern: And if I cast out devils by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? They will be your judges.

verses.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
verses.modern: But if I cast out devils by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

verses.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
verses.modern: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.

verses.kjv: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
verses.modern: But when one stronger than he comes and overpowers him, he takes away his full armor in which he trusted and divides his spoils.

verses.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
verses.modern: Whoever is not with Me is against Me, and whoever does not gather with Me scatters.

verses.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
verses.modern: When the unclean spirit has gone out of a man, it passes through waterless places seeking rest, and finding none it says, 'I will return to my house from which I came.'

verses.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
verses.modern: When it comes, it finds the house swept and in order.

verses.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
verses.modern: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and live there. The final condition of that man is worse than the first."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
verses.modern: As He said these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said to him, "Blessed is the womb that bore You and the breasts that nursed You!"

verses.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
verses.modern: But He said, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"

verses.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
verses.modern: When the crowds were increasing, He began to say, "This is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.

verses.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
verses.modern: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.

verses.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.modern: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon. And a greater than Solomon is here.

verses.kjv: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.modern: The men of Nineveh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah. And a greater than Jonah is here.

verses.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
verses.modern: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a hidden place or under a basket, but on a stand, so that those who come in may see the light.

verses.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
verses.modern: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light. But when your eye is evil, your body is full of darkness.

verses.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
verses.modern: Be careful, then, that the light in you is not darkness.

verses.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
verses.modern: If your whole body is full of light, with no dark part, then it will be completely bright, as when a lamp gives you light with its bright rays.

verses.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
verses.modern: As He was speaking, a Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. He went in and reclined at the table.

verses.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
verses.modern: The Pharisee was surprised to see that he did not first wash before dinner.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
verses.modern: The Lord said to Him, "Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and the dish, but your inside is full of greed and wickedness.

verses.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
verses.modern: You fools! Did not He who made the outside also make the inside?

verses.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
verses.modern: Give what is inside as charity, and all things will be clean for you.

verses.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.modern: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and neglect justice and the love of God. These you should have done, without leaving the others undone.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
verses.modern: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
verses.modern: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, and people walk over them without knowing it."

verses.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
verses.modern: One of the lawyers answered Him, "Master, in saying these things You insult us too."

verses.kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
verses.modern: He said, "Woe to you lawyers also! For you load people with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch those burdens with even one of your fingers.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
verses.modern: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

verses.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
verses.modern: So you are witnesses that you approve of your fathers' deeds — they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.

verses.kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
verses.modern: Therefore the wisdom of God said, 'I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute,'

verses.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
verses.modern: so that the blood of all the prophets shed from the foundation of the world may be charged against this generation —

verses.kjv: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
verses.modern: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zacharias who perished between the altar and the sanctuary. Truly I tell you, it will be charged against this generation.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
verses.modern: Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter yourselves, and you hindered those who were entering."

verses.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
verses.modern: When He left there, the scribes and Pharisees began to press Him fiercely and to interrogate Him about many things,

verses.kjv: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
verses.modern: lying in wait for Him and seeking to catch something from His mouth to accuse Him.

chapters.summary: Jesus teaches His disciples to pray and gives them a model prayer. He casts out a demon and refutes the accusation that He works by Beelzebub, declaring that a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand. He pronounces woes on the Pharisees and lawyers for their hypocrisy.

verses.kjv: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.modern: When countless thousands of people had gathered, so that they were trampling one another, He began to say to His disciples first, "Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

verses.kjv: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
verses.modern: For there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, and nothing hidden that will not be known.

verses.kjv: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.modern: Therefore whatever You have said in the dark will be heard in the light, and what You have whispered behind closed doors will be proclaimed from the rooftops.

verses.kjv: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.modern: I tell You, My friends: do not be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that can do nothing more.

verses.kjv: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.modern: But I will warn You whom to fear: fear Him who, after killing, has authority to cast into hell. Yes, I tell You, fear Him.

verses.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
verses.modern: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten before God.

verses.kjv: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.modern: Indeed, the very hairs of Your head are all numbered. Do not be afraid — you are worth more than many sparrows.

verses.kjv: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
verses.modern: I tell You, whoever acknowledges Me before men, the Son of Man will also acknowledge before the angels of God.

verses.kjv: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
verses.modern: But the one who denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
verses.modern: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven. But the one who blasphemes against the Holy Ghost will not be forgiven.

verses.kjv: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
verses.modern: When they bring You before synagogues and rulers and authorities, do not worry about how You will defend Yourself or what You will say.

verses.kjv: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
verses.modern: For the Holy Ghost will teach You in that very hour what You ought to say."

verses.kjv: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
verses.modern: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Master, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.modern: He said to Him, "Man, who appointed Me a judge or arbitrator over You?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Take care and be on guard against covetousness, for a man's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions."

verses.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.modern: He told them a parable: "The land of a certain rich man produced a great harvest.

verses.kjv: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
verses.modern: He reasoned to Himself, 'What shall I do? I have nowhere to store my crops.'

verses.kjv: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
verses.modern: He said, 'This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

verses.kjv: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
verses.modern: Then I will say to my soul, "Soul, You have many goods stored up for many years. Take Your ease — eat, drink, and be merry."'

verses.kjv: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
verses.modern: But God said to Him, 'Fool! This night Your soul will be required of You. Then whose will those things be that You have stored up?'

verses.kjv: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
verses.modern: That is what happens to the one who stores up treasure for himself and is not rich toward God."

verses.kjv: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
verses.modern: He said to His disciples, "Therefore I tell You, do not worry about Your life — what You will eat — or about Your body — what You will wear.

verses.kjv: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
verses.modern: Life is more than food, and the body more than clothing.

verses.kjv: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verses.modern: Consider the ravens — they neither sow nor reap. They have no storehouse or barn, yet God feeds them. How much more are You worth than birds!

verses.kjv: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
verses.modern: Which of You by worrying can add a single hour to His life?

verses.kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
verses.modern: If then You are not able to do even a very small thing, why do You worry about the rest?

verses.kjv: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.modern: Consider how the lilies grow. They neither toil nor spin. Yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

verses.kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.modern: If God clothes the grass of the field — which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace — how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!

verses.kjv: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
verses.modern: Do not seek what you will eat or what you will drink, and do not be anxious.

verses.kjv: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
verses.modern: For all the nations of the world seek after these things, and your Father knows that you need them.

verses.kjv: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.modern: Instead, seek His kingdom, and these things will be added to you.

verses.kjv: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.modern: Do not be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

verses.kjv: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
verses.modern: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that do not grow old — a treasure in the heavens that does not fail, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.

verses.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.modern: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

verses.kjv: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
verses.modern: Let your loins be girded, and your lamps burning,

verses.kjv: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
verses.modern: Be like men who are waiting for their master to return from a wedding feast, so that when he comes and knocks they can open the door for him immediately.

verses.kjv: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
verses.modern: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds awake when he comes. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself for service, have them recline at the table, and come and serve them.

verses.kjv: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
verses.modern: If he comes in the second or third watch and finds them ready — blessed are those servants.

verses.kjv: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.modern: Know this: if the master of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and not let his house be broken into.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
verses.modern: You also must be ready, for the Son of Man is coming at an hour You do not expect."

verses.kjv: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.modern: Peter said, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us or to everyone?"

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
verses.modern: The Lord said, "Who then is the faithful and wise manager whom the master will put in charge of his household staff, to give them their portion at the right time?

verses.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.modern: Blessed is that servant whom the master finds doing this when he comes.

verses.kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
verses.modern: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

verses.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.modern: But if that servant says in his heart, 'My master is taking a long time to come,' and begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk,

verses.kjv: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
verses.modern: the master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.

verses.kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
verses.modern: That servant who knew his master's will but did not prepare himself or act according to his will shall be beaten with many blows.

verses.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verses.modern: But the one who did not know and did things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone to whom much is given, much will be required. From the one entrusted with much, even more will be asked.

verses.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
verses.modern: I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

verses.kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
verses.modern: I have a baptism to undergo, and how great is My distress until it is accomplished!

verses.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.modern: Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but rather division.

verses.kjv: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.modern: From now on, five in one household will be divided — three against two, and two against three.

verses.kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.modern: Father will be divided against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.

verses.kjv: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
verses.modern: He also said to the crowds, "When you see a cloud rising in the west, you immediately say, 'A shower is coming,' and so it happens.

verses.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
verses.modern: When you see the south wind blowing, you say, 'There will be heat,' and it happens.

verses.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
verses.modern: You hypocrites! You know how to read the appearance of earth and sky, but why do you not know how to read this present time?

verses.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.modern: Why do you not judge for yourselves what is right?

verses.kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
verses.modern: When you go with your accuser before a magistrate, try to settle with him on the way, or he may drag you before the judge, the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

verses.kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
verses.modern: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny."
