verses.modern: He said, "Truly I say to You, this poor widow has put in more than all of them."

verses.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
verses.modern: "For all these have given out of their abundance, but she out of her poverty has put in all the living she had."

verses.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
verses.modern: As some were speaking about the temple — how it was adorned with beautiful stones and offerings — He said,

verses.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.modern: "As for these things that You see — the days will come when there will not be left one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."

verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
verses.modern: They asked Him, "Master, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign when these things are about to take place?"

verses.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
verses.modern: He said, "Watch out that You are not deceived. Many will come in My name, saying, 'I am He,' and 'The time is near.' Do not go after them."

verses.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
verses.modern: "When You hear of wars and uprisings, do not be terrified. These things must happen first, but the end will not come right away."

verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
verses.modern: Then He said to them, "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom."

verses.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
verses.modern: "There will be great earthquakes in various places, famines, and plagues. There will be terrifying events and great signs from heaven."

verses.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
verses.modern: "But before all this, they will lay their hands on You and persecute You. They will hand You over to synagogues and prisons, bringing You before kings and governors because of My name."

verses.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
verses.modern: "This will be Your opportunity to testify."

verses.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
verses.modern: "Settle it in Your hearts not to plan Your defense beforehand."

verses.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
verses.modern: "For I will give You words and wisdom that none of Your opponents will be able to contradict or resist."

verses.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
verses.modern: "You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends. Some of You will be put to death."

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
verses.modern: "You will be hated by everyone because of My name."

verses.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
verses.modern: "But not a hair of Your head will perish."

verses.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.
verses.modern: "By Your endurance You will gain Your lives."

verses.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
verses.modern: "When You see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, know that its destruction is near."

verses.kjv: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
verses.modern: "Then let those who are in Judaea flee to the mountains. Let those who are inside the city get out. Let those who are in the countryside not enter it."

verses.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.modern: "For these are days of vengeance, to fulfill everything that is written."

verses.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
verses.modern: "How terrible it will be for those who are pregnant and for nursing mothers in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people."

verses.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
verses.modern: "They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all nations. Jerusalem will be trampled by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled."

verses.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
verses.modern: "There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars. On earth the nations will be in anguish and confusion as the seas roar and toss."

verses.kjv: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
verses.modern: "People will faint from terror at what is coming on the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken."

verses.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.modern: "Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory."

verses.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
verses.modern: "When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift Your heads, because Your redemption is drawing near."

verses.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
verses.modern: He told them a parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees."

verses.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
verses.modern: "When they put out leaves, You see for yourselves and know that summer is already near."

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
verses.modern: "So also, when You see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near."

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
verses.modern: "Truly I say to You, this generation will not pass away until all has been fulfilled."

verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
verses.modern: "Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away."

verses.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
verses.modern: "Be careful, or Your hearts will be weighed down with carousing, drunkenness, and the worries of this life. That day will close on You suddenly."

verses.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
verses.modern: "For it will come like a trap on everyone who lives on the face of the whole earth."

verses.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
verses.modern: "So watch at all times, and pray that You may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man."

verses.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
verses.modern: Every day He was teaching in the temple. At night He went out and stayed on the mount called the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
verses.modern: All the people came to him early in the morning at the temple to hear Him.

chapters.summary: Jesus commends a poor widow who casts two mites into the treasury, giving more than all the rest. He foretells the destruction of the temple and the signs of the end — wars, earthquakes, persecution, and Jerusalem surrounded by armies — and warns His disciples to watch and pray.

verses.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
verses.modern: The Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was drawing near.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
verses.modern: The chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to kill Him, because they feared the people.

verses.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
verses.modern: Then Satan entered into Judas, who was called Iscariot, one of the twelve.

verses.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
verses.modern: He went away and discussed with the chief priests and officers how He might betray Jesus to them.

verses.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
verses.modern: They were glad and agreed to give Him money.

verses.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.modern: He agreed and looked for an opportunity to betray Him when the crowd was not around.

verses.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
verses.modern: The day of Unleavened Bread came, when the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

verses.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
verses.modern: He sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, so we may eat it."

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
verses.modern: They said to Him, "Where do You want us to prepare it?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
verses.modern: He said to them, "When you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him into the house he enters."

verses.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
verses.modern: "Say to the owner of the house, 'The Master asks you: Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?'"

verses.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
verses.modern: "He will show you a large upper room that is furnished. Prepare it there."

verses.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
verses.modern: They went and found it just as He had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

verses.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
verses.modern: When the hour came, He reclined at the table, and the twelve apostles were with Him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
verses.modern: He said to them, "I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer."

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: "For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."

verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
verses.modern: He took the cup and gave thanks and said, "Take this and share it among yourselves."

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
verses.modern: "For I tell you that from now on I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."

verses.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
verses.modern: He took bread, gave thanks, broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is My body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of Me."

verses.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
verses.modern: In the same way, He took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new testament in My blood, which is shed for you."

verses.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
verses.modern: "But the hand of the one who betrays Me is with Me on the table."

verses.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
verses.modern: "The Son of Man goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom he is betrayed!"

verses.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
verses.modern: They began to ask one another which of them it was who would do this.

verses.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
verses.modern: A dispute also arose among them as to which of them was to be considered the greatest.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
verses.modern: He said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called benefactors."

verses.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
verses.modern: "But it must not be that way among You. Instead, the greatest among You must be like the youngest, and the leader like the one who serves."

verses.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
verses.modern: "For who is greater — the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as the One who serves."

verses.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
verses.modern: "You are those who have stood by Me through My trials."

verses.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
verses.modern: "I appoint to You a kingdom, just as My Father has appointed one to Me."

verses.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: "You will eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and You will sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel."

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
verses.modern: The Lord said, "Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift you as wheat."

verses.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
verses.modern: "But I have prayed for you that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
verses.modern: He said to Him, "Lord, I am ready to go with You both to prison and to death."

verses.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
verses.modern: He said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today before you deny three times that you know Me."

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
verses.modern: He said to them, "When I sent you out without purse, bag, or sandals, did you lack anything?" They said, "Nothing."

verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
verses.modern: He said to them, "But now, let the one who has a purse take it, and likewise a bag. And let the one who has no sword sell his cloak and buy one."

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
verses.modern: "For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: 'And He was numbered with the transgressors.' What is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment."

verses.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
verses.modern: They said, "Lord, look, here are two swords." He said to them, "That is enough."

verses.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
verses.modern: He went out and made His way, as was His custom, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples followed Him.

verses.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
verses.modern: When He arrived at the place, He said to them, "Pray that you do not enter into temptation."

verses.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
verses.modern: He withdrew from them about a stone's throw away, knelt down, and prayed.

verses.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
verses.modern: He said, "Father, if You are willing, remove this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours, be done."

verses.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
verses.modern: An angel from heaven appeared to Him, strengthening Him.

verses.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
verses.modern: Being in agony, He prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

verses.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
verses.modern: When He rose from prayer and came to His disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from grief.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
verses.modern: He said to them, "Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you do not enter into temptation."

verses.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
verses.modern: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived. The one called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came close to Jesus to kiss Him.

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
verses.modern: But Jesus said to Him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"

verses.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
verses.modern: When those around Him saw what was about to happen, they said, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"

verses.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.modern: One of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.modern: Jesus answered, "No more of this!" He touched the man's ear and healed him.

verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
verses.modern: Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple, and the elders who had come to seize Him, "Have You come out with swords and clubs as if You were coming against a robber?"

verses.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
verses.modern: "Every day I was with You in the temple, and You did not lay a hand on Me. But this is Your hour — the time when darkness rules."

verses.kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
verses.modern: They seized Him, led Him away, and brought Him into the high priest's house. Peter followed at a distance.

verses.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
verses.modern: When they had lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.

verses.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
verses.modern: A servant girl saw him sitting by the fire. She stared at him and said, "This man was with him too."

verses.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
verses.modern: He denied it, saying, "Woman, I do not know Him."

verses.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
verses.modern: A little later someone else saw him and said, "You are one of them too." Peter said, "Man, I am not."

verses.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
verses.modern: About an hour later someone else insisted, "This man was certainly with him, for he is a Galilean."

verses.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
verses.modern: Peter said, "Man, I do not know what you are saying." Immediately, while he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.

verses.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.modern: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Peter remembered the word of the Lord — how he had said to Him, "Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times."

verses.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.modern: Peter went out and wept bitterly.

verses.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
verses.modern: The men who were holding Jesus mocked Him and struck Him.

verses.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
verses.modern: They blindfolded Him, hit Him, and demanded, "Prophesy! Who struck You?"

verses.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
verses.modern: They said many other blasphemous things against Him.

verses.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
verses.modern: When day came, the elders of the people — the chief priests and scribes — assembled together and led Him before their council.

verses.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
verses.modern: They said, "If You are the Christ, tell us." He said to them, "If I tell You, You will not believe."

verses.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
verses.modern: "And if I ask You, You will not answer Me or let Me go."

verses.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
verses.modern: "But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God."

verses.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
verses.modern: They all said, "Are You then the Son of God?" He said to them, "You say that I am."

verses.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
verses.modern: They said, "What further need do we have of testimony? We have heard it ourselves from His own mouth."

chapters.summary: Judas agrees to betray Jesus for money, and Jesus observes the Last Supper with His disciples, instituting the new covenant in His blood. He prays in agony on the Mount of Olives, is betrayed by Judas, arrested, denied three times by Peter, and beaten and mocked by the guards.

verses.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
verses.modern: The whole assembly rose and brought Him before Pilate.

verses.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
verses.modern: They began to accuse Him, saying, "We found this man misleading our nation, forbidding us to pay taxes to Caesar, and saying that He Himself is Christ, a king."

verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
verses.modern: Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" He answered him, "You say so."

verses.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
verses.modern: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no guilt in this man."

verses.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
verses.modern: They pressed harder, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, from Galilee all the way to this place."

verses.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
verses.modern: When Pilate heard "Galilee," he asked whether the man was a Galilean.

verses.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
verses.modern: When He learned that Jesus was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

verses.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
verses.modern: When Herod saw Jesus, He was greatly pleased, for He had wanted to see Him for a long time. He had heard many things about Him and hoped to see some miracle performed by Him.

verses.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
verses.modern: He questioned Jesus at length, but Jesus gave Him no answer.

verses.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
verses.modern: The chief priests and scribes stood there, accusing Him forcefully.

verses.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
verses.modern: Herod and his soldiers treated him with contempt and mocked Him. They put a splendid robe on Him and sent Him back to Pilate.

verses.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
verses.modern: That same day Pilate and Herod became friends with each other. Before this, they had been enemies.

verses.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.modern: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people.

verses.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
verses.modern: He said to them, "You brought this man to me as one who was misleading the people. I have examined him before you and found no guilt in Him regarding the charges you bring against Him."

verses.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
verses.modern: "Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us. He has done nothing deserving of death."

verses.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
verses.modern: "I will therefore punish Him and release Him."

verses.kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
verses.modern: For it was necessary for him to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

verses.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
verses.modern: They all cried out together, "Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!"

verses.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
verses.modern: This was a man who had been thrown into prison for a rebellion in the city and for murder.

verses.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
verses.modern: Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, spoke to them again.

verses.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
verses.modern: But they kept shouting, "Crucify Him! Crucify Him!"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
verses.modern: A third time He said to them, "Why? What wrong has He done? I have found no reason to put Him to death. I will therefore punish Him and release Him."

verses.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.modern: But they kept urgently demanding with loud voices that He be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests won out.

verses.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
verses.modern: Pilate gave his verdict that their demand should be granted.

verses.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.modern: He released the man who had been thrown in prison for rebellion and murder — the one they demanded — and He handed Jesus over to their will.

verses.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
verses.modern: As they led Him away, they seized a man named Simon of Cyrene, who was coming in from the country, and placed the cross on Him to carry it behind Jesus.

verses.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
verses.modern: A great crowd of people followed Him, including women who were mourning and weeping for Him.

verses.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
verses.modern: But Jesus turned to them and said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me. Weep for yourselves and for Your children."

verses.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
verses.modern: "For the days are coming when they will say, 'Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore children, and the breasts that never nursed.'"

verses.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
verses.modern: "Then they will begin to say to the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and to the hills, 'Cover us!'"

verses.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
verses.modern: "For if they do these things when the wood is green, what will happen when it is dry?"

verses.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
verses.modern: Two others — criminals — were also led out to be put to death with Him.

verses.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
verses.modern: When they came to the place called Calvary, they crucified Him there, along with the criminals — one on His right and one on His left.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verses.modern: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." They divided His clothes by casting lots.

verses.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
verses.modern: The people stood watching. The rulers sneered at him, saying, "He saved others. Let Him save Himself, if He is the Christ of God, His Chosen One."

verses.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
verses.modern: The soldiers also mocked Him, coming up and offering Him sour wine.

verses.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
verses.modern: They said, "If You are the King of the Jews, save yourself."

verses.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
verses.modern: A sign was also written over Him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
verses.modern: One of the criminals hanging there railed at Him, saying, "If You are the Christ, save Yourself and us!"

verses.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
verses.modern: But the other rebuked Him, saying, "Do You not fear God, since You are under the same sentence of condemnation?"

verses.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
verses.modern: "We are receiving what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."

verses.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verses.modern: He said, "Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom."

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.modern: Jesus said to Him, "Truly I say to You, today You will be with Me in paradise."

verses.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
verses.modern: It was about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

verses.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
verses.modern: The sun was darkened, and the curtain of the temple was torn in two.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
verses.modern: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, "Father, into Your hands I commit My spirit." Having said this, He breathed His last.

verses.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
verses.modern: When the centurion saw what had happened, he praised God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous man."

verses.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
verses.modern: All the crowds who had gathered for this spectacle, when they saw what had taken place, went home beating their chests.

verses.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
verses.modern: All those who knew Him, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
verses.modern: There was a man named Joseph, a member of the council. He was a good and righteous man.

verses.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
verses.modern: He had not agreed with their decision and action. He was from Arimathaea, a town in Judea, and he was waiting for the kingdom of God.

verses.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
verses.modern: This man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

verses.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
verses.modern: He took it down and wrapped it in linen cloth. He placed it in a tomb cut from rock, in which no one had ever been laid.

verses.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
verses.modern: That day was the Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.

verses.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
verses.modern: The women who had come with Him from Galilee followed and saw the tomb and how His body was placed.

verses.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
verses.modern: Then they went back and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested, according to the commandment.

chapters.summary: Jesus is brought before Pilate and Herod, who find no fault in Him, but the crowd demands His crucifixion and the release of Barabbas. Jesus is crucified between two thieves, and one repents and is promised paradise. Jesus commits His spirit to the Father and dies, and Joseph of Arimathaea buries Him.

verses.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
verses.modern: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared. Some others came with them.

verses.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
verses.modern: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

verses.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
verses.modern: When they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
verses.modern: While they were puzzled about this, two men in dazzling clothing suddenly stood by them.

verses.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
verses.modern: The women were terrified and bowed their faces to the ground. The men said to them, "Why do You seek the living among the dead?"

verses.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
verses.modern: "He is not here. He has risen! Remember how He spoke to You when He was still in Galilee."

verses.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
verses.modern: "He said, 'The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified, and on the third day rise again.'"

verses.kjv: And they remembered his words,
verses.modern: They remembered His words.

verses.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.modern: They returned from the tomb and reported all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

verses.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
verses.modern: These women were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them also told these things to the apostles.

verses.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
verses.modern: But these words seemed like nonsense to the apostles, and they did not believe the women.

verses.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
verses.modern: Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping down, he saw only the linen cloths lying there. He went away, wondering to himself about what had happened.

verses.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
verses.modern: That same day, two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
verses.modern: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
verses.modern: While they were talking and discussing these things, Jesus Himself drew near and walked with them.

verses.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
verses.modern: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
verses.modern: He said to them, "What manner of conversation is this that You have with one another as You walk, and are sad?"

verses.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
verses.modern: One of them, named Cleopas, answered Him, "Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in these days?"

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
verses.modern: He said to them, "What things?" They said to Him, "Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people."

verses.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
verses.modern: "How the chief priests and our rulers handed Him over to be condemned to death, and they crucified Him."

verses.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
verses.modern: "We had hoped that He was the one to redeem Israel. Besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened."

verses.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
verses.modern: "Some women from our group also astonished us. They were at the tomb early this morning."

verses.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
verses.modern: "When they did not find His body, they came back saying they had seen a vision of angels who said He was alive."

verses.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
verses.modern: "Some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but they did not see Him."

verses.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
verses.modern: He said to them, "How foolish You are, and how slow of heart to believe everything the prophets have spoken!"

verses.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
verses.modern: "Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then enter into His glory?"

verses.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.modern: Beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was written about Himself throughout all the Scriptures.

verses.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
verses.modern: They drew near to the village they were heading to, and He acted as though He would go on further.

verses.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
verses.modern: But they urged Him, saying, "Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is nearly over." So He went in to stay with them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
verses.modern: While He was at the table with them, He took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them.

verses.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.modern: Their eyes were opened and they recognized Him. Then He vanished from their sight.

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
verses.modern: They said to each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while He talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"

verses.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
verses.modern: They got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem. They found the eleven and those with them gathered together.

verses.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
verses.modern: These were saying, "The Lord has truly risen and has appeared to Simon!"

verses.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
verses.modern: The two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized Him in the breaking of the bread.

verses.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
verses.modern: While they were still talking about these things, Jesus Himself stood among them and said to them, "Peace be to You."

verses.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.modern: They were startled and frightened, thinking they were seeing a ghost.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
verses.modern: He said to them, "Why are You troubled? Why do doubts arise in Your hearts?"

verses.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
verses.modern: "Look at My hands and My feet — it is I Myself. Touch Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as You see I have."

verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
verses.modern: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.

verses.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
verses.modern: While they still could not believe it for joy and were marveling, He said to them, "Have You anything here to eat?"

verses.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
verses.modern: They gave Him a piece of broiled fish and some honeycomb.

verses.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.
verses.modern: He took it and ate it in their presence.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
verses.modern: He said to them, "These are My words that I spoke to you while I was still with you — that everything written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms must be fulfilled."

verses.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
verses.modern: Then He opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
verses.modern: He said to them, "This is what is written: the Christ must suffer and rise from the dead on the third day."

verses.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: "Repentance and forgiveness of sins must be proclaimed in His name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem."

verses.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.
verses.modern: "You are witnesses of these things."

verses.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
verses.modern: "I am sending the promise of My Father upon You. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until You are clothed with power from on high."

verses.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.modern: He led them out as far as Bethany. He lifted up His hands and blessed them.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
verses.modern: While He was blessing them, He was parted from them and carried up into heaven.

verses.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verses.modern: They worshiped Him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

verses.kjv: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
verses.modern: They were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

chapters.summary: Women come to the tomb on the first day of the week and find it empty, and two angels announce that Jesus has risen. The risen Jesus walks with two disciples on the road to Emmaus and reveals Himself to them in the breaking of bread. He appears to the gathered disciples, commissions them as witnesses, and ascends into heaven from Bethany.
